senses.gloss:
mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ)
A check, a restraint, any person or thing that restrains, &c.
m. (-न्ता)
1 A charioteer.
2 An elephantdriver.
E.
यम to restrain, aff. तृच्.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (यन्त्रति यन्त्रयति)
To restrain: see यत्रि.

n. (-न्त्रं)
1 A machine in general, any implement or apparatus.
2 A diagram of a mystical nature, or astrological character.
3 A sort of vessel.
4 Restraining, checking, controlling.
E.
यम to check, Uṇādi aff. त्र.

m. (-कः)
A lathe.
f. (-का)
A wife's younger sister.
E.
यन्त्र a machine or restraining, &c., and कन् added.

n. (-हः)
1 An oil mill.
2 A manufactory.
E.
यन्त्र any machine, the apparatus used for grinding substances yielding oil, and गृह a house.

m. (-लः)
Common pea.
E.
यन्त्र a machine, and गोल. round.

n. (-णं)
1 Pain, anguish, affliction.
2 Binding, confining.
3 Checking, controlling, especially the passions.
E.
यत्रि to restrain, &c., aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-णी)
A handmill.
E.
यन्त्र a machine, and पेषणी a stone for grinding on.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bound, tied, chained, fettered.
2 Checked, restrained.
E.
यन्त्र restraining, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
Restrained in speech, constrained to be silent.
E.
यन्त्रित, and कथा speech.

n. (-नं)
1 Any vehicle or form of conveyance, as a carriage, a litter, a horse, an elephant, &c.
2 Going, marching, proceeding.
3 Invading, marching against an enemy.
E.
या to go, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-त्रं)
A vessel, a ship, a boat.
E.
यान going, (by water,) and पात्र a cup or vessel; also with कन् added यानपात्रक; n. (-कं.)

n. (-खं)
The forepart of a carriage, the pole or part where the yoke is fixed.
E.
यान a vehicle, and मुख face or front.

m. (-मी)
The owner of a vehicle.
E.
यान, and स्वामिन master.
